notes: Firm-year panel of Chinese listed firms 2002-2016 (17,740 rows, 2,327 firms, 221 cities, 27 provinces), unbalanced. Firms never change city; cities never change province; sgaige is constant within city-year. Treatment sgaige = 1 if the incumbent city party secretary joined the CPC after 1978. Province-by-year FE: the authors' provyear = province*year is a unique code for each of the 397 province-year cells (checked), entered here as xt_vars = province (t^province FE). g_city = first year with sgaige = 1 among the city's years in maindata.dta (city-level adoption, shared by all firms in the city; NA for 18 never-treated cities). City paths: 105 clean switch-ons, 67 cities that revert at least once (37 of them treated at first observation), 31 always treated, 18 never treated. In-sample cohorts with an untreated pre-period (cities): 2003:10, 2004:11, 2005:6, 2006:11, 2007:20, 2008:8, 2009:22, 2010:9, 2011:3, 2012:14, 2013:6, 2014:6, 2015:2, 2016:7; 68 cities are treated in their first observed year (45 in 2002). switch_off = 1 for rows with year >= g_city and sgaige = 0 (2,099 firm-years, 556 firms, 67 cities); sample_filter drops them (Hull fn 6, PROTOCOL Sec. 5b). On the kept rows D = 1[year >= g_city] equals sgaige (checked). Dropping switch-offs moves the raw TWFE from -0.0210737 (SE 0.0086553 fixest areg-like dof, 17,740 rows) to -0.0111067 (0.0110705, 15,641 rows), so the runner TWFE does not equal published/SD by construction. Expected runner TWFE = -0.0111067 / 0.2909228 (population SD after the drop) = -0.038177. Sensitivity of the TWFE to the adoption-date rule (raw coef, rows kept): firm-level first treated year -0.008128 (16,296); city-level from secpref.dta full 2002-2016 secretary path -0.012788 (15,605). Columns 2-4 of Table 4 and all other tables add time-varying controls or use other designs (ineligible).
